## Download 2DriveScan {{VERSION}}

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon & Intel) | `2DriveScan_{{VERSION}}_universal.dmg` |
| **Windows** (x64) | `2DriveScan_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe` or `2DriveScan_{{VERSION}}_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **Windows** (ARM64) | `2DriveScan_{{VERSION}}_arm64-setup.exe` |
| **Linux** – Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `2DriveScan_{{VERSION}}_amd64.deb` / `_arm64.deb` |
| **Linux** – Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL | `2DriveScan-{{VERSION}}-1.x86_64.rpm` / `.aarch64.rpm` |
| **Linux** – any distribution (Arch, Manjaro, …) | `2DriveScan_{{VERSION}}_amd64.AppImage` / `_aarch64.AppImage` |

### First launch

- **macOS:** for a complete picture of your disk, grant 2DriveScan **Full Disk Access** in
  *System Settings → Privacy & Security*. If macOS says it cannot verify the developer (unsigned builds), click
  **Open Anyway** in the same settings pane.
- **Windows:** SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux AppImage:** make the file executable (`chmod +x 2DriveScan_*.AppImage`) and run it.
